title: fix(ui/.claude): make the console-build-test launch entry repository-relative
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DPwjLgyx7d9VWknu12BbjRU)_

Fixes #27668
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ui/.claude/launch.json` 里指南让 agent 照抄的 `console-build-test` 条目，去掉写死的本机 `/Users/...` 旧 objectui worktree 路径，改为从 `ui/` 出发 `cd apps/console`，端口换成指南示例的每 agent 端口（后端 4010、前端 5190）。
- 为什么改：原条目只能在一位维护者的笔记本上、按合仓前目录跑通，照抄它的 agent 起不来 preview，也绕开了多 agent 端口隔离的约定。
- 风险与回滚：仅改一条桌面 preview 配置的两处字面量，不碰产品代码与指南规则；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/.claude/launch.json:19-21`（`console-build-test` 的命令与 `port`）。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `bash -lc "cd apps/console && VITE_SERVER_URL= DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 exec pnpm dev --port 5190 --strictPort"`，预期 vite 在 :5190 就绪，`/api` 代理指向 :4010。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（contract review owed，Tier S 由席位复核 PASS 且 CI 全绿后落地）。

## What changes

`ui/.claude/launch.json`, entry `console-build-test` (the one `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md:564` tells agents to imitate):

- command: `cd /Users/…/objectui/.wt-aipicker/apps/console && … DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4000 … --port 5181 --strictPort` → `cd apps/console && VITE_SERVER_URL= DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010 exec pnpm dev --port 5190 --strictPort`
- `port`: 5181 → 5190

The entry name and shape are unchanged, so the guide's pointer line already matches and is not touched. No change to the guide.

## Acceptance notes

- **Launch runner cwd = `ui/`** (measured from the file itself): the sibling entries `grid-bulk-demo` / `gantt-demo` run `pnpm --dir packages/plugin-grid …`, a path that only resolves from `ui/`, the directory that holds this `.claude/`. So `cd apps/console` is the right relative path.
- **Ports** are the per-agent example the guide's 「每个 agent 独立测试栈」 section uses (backend `-p 4010`, console `--port 5190 --strictPort`), and stay clear of the guide's 「绝不动 :3000 / :5180」.
- `VITE_SERVER_URL=` is kept: it pins the same-origin relative `/api` that `apps/console/.env.development` documents, even when the shell exports a value.

## Verification

- `grep -n '/Users/' ui/.claude/launch.json` → no hits (exit 1). File parses as JSON.
- Fresh worktree at `origin/main` b83baed2 + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`: ran the entry's command from `ui/` → `VITE v8.3.5 ready`, `GET http://localhost:5190/` → 200, `GET /api/v1/discovery` → 502 with `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:4010` (no backend started; proves the proxy target). Stopped by its own PID.
